item.title: What Trump's prime-time TV pitch means for war on Iran
item.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump is telling Americans that while his objectives for the war against Iran are nearly achieved, he intends to escalate military operations for at least another two weeks.

item.title: Trump says 'core strategic objectives' in Iran are near completion, without providing precise timeline
item.summary: U.S. President ​Donald Trump said on ​Wednesday evening that ⁠Iran ⁠has ‌been decimated and that the ⁠hard part of ‌the war is done, telling Americans that his "core strategic objectives" are near completion and that the war will end soon.

item.title: Iran's nuclear constraints were more diplomatic than technical. Then the bombs started dropping
item.summary: Nuclear weapons experts who were involved in U.S. efforts to sanction and contain Iran say the decision to attack the country is more likely to restart its nuclear program than dismantle it. A regime that previously believed that pausing at a "threshold" stage of 60 per cent e...

item.title: Tracking deaths in Iran, wider Middle East as conflict rages on
item.summary: As the Middle East war enters a second month, thousands of people have been killed in the regional conflict that began when U.S. and Israel targeted Iran, which quickly pulled in neighbouring countries and opened a new front in Lebanon.

item.title: Wall Street rallies Wednesday amid hope for end to war with Iran
item.summary: Stocks are climbing worldwide, and oil prices are easing Wednesday as hopes build that the war with Iran could end soon.

item.title: Iran denies Trump's claim that it wants a ceasefire
item.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump said Wednesday that Iran's president wants a ceasefire in the Mideast war, a claim Tehran quickly denied.

item.title: Justices grill Trump administration lawyer on ending birthright citizenship, with president in attendance
item.summary: Supreme Court justices, with Donald Trump breaking historical precedent by attending oral arguments, tackled the legality of his executive order to restrict birthright citizenship in the U.S., a contentious part of his administration's immigration approach.

item.title: Conversion therapy survivors on edge as U.S. Supreme Court strikes down ban
item.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court has ruled that banning conversion therapy for minors is a violation of free speech. But a man who once underwent the practice himself says it's about protecting vulnerable young people from serious — and sometimes fatal — harm.

item.title: North Korea expands its nuclear arsenal after witnessing Iran’s vulnerability
item.summary: Ever since becoming leader in 2011, North Korean Leader Kim Jong-un has made his nuclear weapons program a national goal — almost a doctrine — arguing it is the only way for smaller powers to keep from being "mercilessly violated" by superpowers.

item.title: IN PHOTOS | Launch of Artemis II mission
item.summary: The Artemis II SLS rocket with the Orion capsule and its crew blasted off from the Kennedy Space Center in Cape Canaveral, Fla., on Wednesday on a nearly 10-day mission that's expected to take them around the moon and back to Earth.
